दक्षिण रेलवे/SOUTHERN RAILWAY 

No.PUB/MAS/2024/08/05                                   Date: 15.08.2024 

PRESS RELEASE 

CHENNAI DIVISION CELEBRATES 78TH INDEPENDENCE DAY 

Chennai Division celebrated 78th Independence Day today (15.08.2024) at RPF 
Parade Ground, Ayanavaram, Chennai. The Divisional Railway Manager hoisted the National Flag.
